snippet.title: Rogue Mansion ►Top Hat Studios Showcase Trailer
snippet.description:
An unexplained tragedy brings together the fate of a group of strangers, inside an ever-shifting mansion of horrors. ROGUE MANSION is the classic survival horror revival you've been waiting for, combined with roguelike mechanics for endless replayability.  Coming soon.
